messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we've updated the SDK deprecation policy and docs guidance. We're shortening the removal window from 90 -> 45 days for minor surface-breaking changes (param renames, default tweaks). Major API removals still require 90d + Eng/PM sign-off. Please read the playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk-deprecation-updates and review by EOD Friday. :loudspeaker:
kevin: Clarify — 45 days for all breakages or only for parameter/default changes?
maria: Only minor surface changes. I added a decision matrix and examples in the doc that map change types to timelines and required approvals.
alex: Will there be migration helpers or codemods for customers?
maria: Yes — shipping a lightweight migration helper (CLI) + codemod in the SDK repo. Example usage below. If you want to test, there's a canary build scheduled next week.
alex: ```
# run from repo root
npx redwood-migrate fix-params --from=oldParam --to=newParam
```
sam: Are we aligning release cadence with the shorter window? Weekly patches means more coordination.
maria: We'll run weekly patch releases for the quarter. Release window: Wed 09:00 PT. Engineering will gate major removals; weekly patches will be limited to non-breaking and the sanctioned minor migrations. CI will auto-tag deprecation PRs.
ci-bot: Scheduled: weekly-sdk-canary at 2024-05-01T16:00Z — canary will include migration shims and the new lint rule.
emma: How are we communicating to customers? Release notes only, or email + dashboard banners?
maria: Both. Docs team will publish a "what changed" summary with copy + code samples. Marketing will send an email to active signups and enterprise CSMs will get a tailored note. Add a "customer-impact" checkbox to PRs for any deprecation.
kevin: If an enterprise customer needs an exemption/longer runway, what's the process?
maria: Open a ticket in #support-enterprise and tag it 'depr-exemption'. PM + Legal review within 72h; engineering can create a pinned compatibility flag for specific accounts if approved.
alex: I'll add a pre-commit lint that flags deprecated param usage and a codemod task in CI.
maria: Awesome, thanks. Tag @docs and @eng-release in PRs. I'll post a short FAQ follow-up later today and link the migration repo. :memo:
